root_cause: The shared negotiation oracle asserted NoCommonProfile for every negotiation failure, but a frame-decoded hello that fails Hello::validate negotiates to PayloadInvalid. The oracle fired on deterministic seed seed-0004 (a decodable-but-invalid hello frame) once the Hello arm was wired into check_frame.
disposition: check_negotiated_hello accepts NoCommonProfile (incompatible valid hellos) and PayloadInvalid (decoded-but-invalid hellos); the negotiate() doc sentence claiming validation failures map to NoCommonProfile is an S20-410 owner-lane divergence (decision packet round-7-smp1-negotiate).
expected: The minimized input executes without panic; negotiation of an invalid hello fails with PayloadInvalid or NoCommonProfile, never an unlisted code.
